info.title: Elvorance Enterprise API
info.description: Independent domain services with database ownership, verified OIDC identity, tenant and actor scoping, explicit versioned commands and transactional outbox/inbox. Rep server workflows include customer/discovery, catalog-controlled quotations, visits/routes, tasks/opportunities, profile, conversations and location. Commands require Idempotency-Key; money uses integer minor units. List endpoints use bounded cursor pagination. In-app messages and payment records do not execute external communications or payments. Physical-device/store acceptance is a separate release gate.
